description: Chainlink on-chain price feed (ETH/USD or BTC/USD, Ethereum mainnet): latest round answer in USD, round id, and the start and update times with the age of the last update in seconds. Only the two feeds listed here are supported. Heartbeat and deviation thresholds are not reported. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.
name: crypto_chainlink_price_feeds
title: Chainlink on-chain price feed: latest round answer in USD
